ideal: A short alert that Microsoft (8-K item 2.02 earnings release plus 10-Q quarterly report) and Alphabet (8-K item 2.02 earnings release) posted quarterly results, with links. It could also note Microsoft's separate 8.01 'other events' 8-K, should skip the proxy-related PX14A6G, and should invent no price moves.

verdicts.note: Clean, correct links for both companies' earnings filings and the 10-Q; it only omits the minor 8.01 8-K.
verdicts.answer:
Microsoft: quarterly results out — 10-Q (quarterly report) plus an 8-K earnings release. https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/789019/000119312526436133/msft-20260930.htm
Microsoft earnings 8-K (results of operations): https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/789019/000119312526436122/msft-20261028.htm
Alphabet: quarterly results out — 8-K earnings release (results of operations). https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1652044/000165204426000080/goog-20261028.htm

It links Microsoft's 8.01 'other events' 8-K as though it were the results filing and omits the actual 2.02 earnings 8-K link.
verdicts.answer:
Microsoft filed an 8‑K (results of operations and other events) and a 10‑Q quarterly report; see https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/789019/000119312526436149/msft-20261028.htm and https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/789019/000119312526436133/msft-20260930.htm

verdicts.note: Accurate summary, but it has no links, which the rules require for filings.
verdicts.answer: Microsoft filed a quarterly report (10-Q) and released quarterly earnings results (8-K, items 2.02). Alphabet also released quarterly earnings results (8-K, items 2.02, 9.01).

verdicts.note: Complete and accurate, with correct links, plain explanations of the filing types, and an honest note on the unexplained 8.01 filing; it is slightly wordy.
verdicts.answer:
Microsoft: posted quarterly earnings in a current-events report (8-K, item 2.02 = results) and filed its quarterly report (10-Q). No unusual price move versus the S&P 500 in the report. 8-K: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/789019/000119312526436122/msft-20261028.htm · 10-Q: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/789019/000119312526436133/msft-20260930.htm
Microsoft: a second 8-K under "other events" (item 8.01). The report doesn't say what it covers: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/789019/000119312526436149/msft-20261028.htm
Alphabet: posted quarterly earnings in a current-events report (8-K, item 2.02). No unusual price move versus the S&P 500 in the report. https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1652044/000165204426000080/goog-20261028.htm
